contracts.title: Isolated Windows candidate build pipeline
contracts.summary: Accepted source identities can produce privately validated Qt and React shell candidates through a recoverable build queue.
contracts.limitation: This verifies development infrastructure only. Native model provisioning, inference, licensing and release acceptance remain separate gates.

contracts.title: Native reasoning acceptance
contracts.summary: Independent native evaluation verified the defined transaction and symbolic reasoning criteria on the accepted source.
contracts.limitation: Acceptance is limited to the independently reviewed criteria and does not guarantee arbitrary answer correctness.
